Subject: Weekly numbers sweep — submission window & 15m ops huddle

Team — quick heads-up for this week’s forecast flow. Goal: finalize submissions by EOD Friday so finance has a clean dump Monday morning. Key asks below (takes ~10–15m):

1) Stage hygiene: set stage to "Late Opportunity" only if legal/procurement confirmed in writing. Otherwise leave in "Negotiation" and add a short "procurement-pending" note.
2) Commit flags: only mark as "Commit" when both (a) PO/commit email received and (b) expected start date in calendar.
3) Evidence: attach the mutual action plan or procurement note to the deal record (I attached the snapshot).

Agenda for the 15-minute ops huddle (Wed 09:15 PT — link in related_links):
- 09:15–09:18: quick pass on any newly promoted commits
- 09:18–09:22: triage 1-2 risky late-stage deals (owner-level asks)
- 09:22–09:25: confirm final submission owners and timeboxes

Attachments: 2026-11-02-pipeline-snapshot.xlsx (latest filter by stage), mutual-action-plan-ACME.docx
Owner notes: Marissa — please lead the ACME row, Karthik — call out any legal/procurement blockers, Laura — sweep for missing attachments and tag deals with missing evidence.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
